crime_highlights: He facilitated her drug use, supplying her with alcohol and drugs or money to buy drugs
There was an obvious power imbalance which Mr. Hooper took advantage of sexually for his own gratification
Mr. Hooper's blameworthiness is compounded by the degrading nature of the two specific incidents

the mitigating effect of these circumstances is slight

crime_highlights: Mr. Gallagher approached the group of friends and started a fight with Mr. Krystik and Mr. Crippen
he had pulled a loaded handgun out of his shorts
Mr. Gallagher began shooting the gun, including in the air and into the sand where Mr. Krystik and Mr. Crippen were located
Mr. Gallagher also raised the handgun and pointed it at Danyka
they discovered that Mr. Krystik had been shot through the hip and he was bleeding profusely
rationale_highlights: his Indigenous heritage and the impact of Gladue factors on his moral culpability for these offences

exposed to unhealthy lifestyles among community members in his home community (although not within his immediate family) which were the result of the impact of residential schools and colonization of Indigenous people
The fact that he has suffered those Gladue factors is sufficient to reduce his moral culpability for these offences to some degree.
note: Court adopts earlier judge's Gladue findings; ultimately stresses denunciation and deterrence.

crime_highlights: Nlits and WICK also provided Mr. Johnson-Audain with encouragement, imploring him to not hesitate in shooting Mr. Jhutty and to not get distracted
Mr. Johnson-Audain followed the instructions that he received from Nlits and WICK on multiple occasions
Mr. Johnson-Audain crashed a stolen vehicle into a parked vehicle that he believed Mr. Jhutty was driving
Ms. Bhatti suffered bruising to her face, a nosebleed, and a concussion as a result of this incident
rationale_highlights: Mr. Johnson-Audain's degree of responsibility must be assessed in light of his social context, including his experiences as a racialized Black man
Mr. Johnson-Audain has endured pervasive and traumatic experiences of racism and systemic disadvantage
Clearly, those experiences have some connection to the offending at bar, and attenuate his blameworthiness
note: Joint submission case; IRCA described in para 11.
